invariants.rationale: A null writeConfig would likely cause downstream errors; many factory or index methods assume non-null configuration.

meta.value: ensures method parameter is not null

invariants.rationale: The write configuration schema is commonly required for computing index structure; thus, schema should be set.

meta.value: schema used in indexing is defined

invariants.rationale: Creating an index requires an explicit index type; this option must be available on the config.
Typically, creation of an index presupposes that indexing is enabled in the configuration.

meta.value: indexing is expected to be enabled when creating an index

invariants.rationale: If the index type is explicitly 'NONE', index creation is not meaningful.

meta.value: cannot create index if type is NONE
